--input carries a key that this CLI does not model and therefore did not check: "priority". It is sent to the server exactly as written. This is NOT a claim that it is invalid, and NOT a claim that the server ignores it: this CLI does not vendor the server's graph nodes, so "unrecognised here" is the whole of what it knows. The server decides what the key does, including what it costs — --dry-run prices the graph with it included, so the server's own estimate is where a price effect would show. Check the spelling against the graph you copied it from
